title: Finite type locality core for coherent modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ an open cover of $X$. Restriction to open subschemes is as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and coherence and finite type are as in [pqf-def-coherent]. Then (1) coherence of $F$ implies that $F|_W$ is of finite type for every open $W\subseteq X$, and (2) coherence of $F|_{U_i}$ for every $i$ implies that $F$ is of finite type. No quasi-compactness or finiteness assumption on the cover is required.

proof.text: Project coherence of F to finite type. At each point of W, intersect a finite-generating neighbourhood in X with W. By the explicit open-immersion restriction functor, the finite free epimorphism restricts to one with the same number of generators and target F restricted to that intersection. These neighbourhoods cover W, proving finite type of F restricted to W.

Project coherence on each U_i to finite type. For x in X choose i with x in U_i using the cover equality. A finite-generating neighbourhood of x in U_i is open in X because U_i is open. The explicit restriction formula identifies the same sections and epimorphism with generators of F there. This proves finite type of F. Empty opens are vacuous; an empty index type forces X empty.
